stream_observation: one Bernoulli observation per evaluation stream per rollout
strict_group_policy: reject and count cells where observed streams != n_eval
duplicate_policy: accumulate repeated buffered levels; reject and count duplicate new groups
mixed_batch_policy: process existing level identities before any new-level eviction
checkpoint_policy: require saved PLR buffer and exact stored static PLR signature
rank_policy_default: source-faithful stable rank; exact ties inherit stable buffer-slot order
rank_policy_opt_in: for each exact filled-score tie at one-indexed ranks l..r, assign every member mean(j^(-1/temp), j=l..r) before score normalization
rank_normalization_policy: tie-aware mode sums unnormalized score masses in canonical ascending value order so normalized score/replay probabilities are bitwise buffer-slot-permutation equivariant; opt-out retains source slot-order arithmetic; with all distinct scores raw singleton masses are bit-identical and normalized stable-vs-tie probabilities are mathematically equivalent within absolute float32 tolerance 5e-7
rank_activation_policy: tie_aware_score_ranks is explicit, defaults false, and requires use_score_ranks=true and temp>0
comparison_policy: exact Frontier and group-matched MaxMC opt in; the source-faithful official MaxMC reference remains stable-rank
rank_tie_equality: exact floating-point equality; +0 and -0 tie; no epsilon jitter
rank_nonfinite_policy: reject and count nonfinite update candidates; any nonfinite filled score makes the replay distribution all-NaN and fails host receipt validation
rank_unfilled_policy: unfilled slots do not participate in ranking, tie blocks, mass, or diagnostics
sampling_policy: sequential replay draws with replacement; force_unique deduplicates buffer updates and does not resample replay draws
telemetry_policy: report exact-score tie summaries, score/replay effective support, and separate last/cumulative replay draw, distinct-slot, and duplicate-draw counts; last values persist until the next actual replay batch
xpid_policy: all PLR runs encode overlay version and contract hash
